Zoroastrianism is a persian religion founded by [[Zarathustra]]. 

It has a few links to [[Lifeism]]

* As a source for reconstructions of [[Proto Indo European Myth]]
* Direct influence through its dualistic cosmology
* Secondary influence through its influence on [[Manichaeism]]
*Tertiary influence through the influence of Manichaeism on [[Augustine of Hippo]]
* Tertiary influence through the influence of Manichaeism on [[Mahayana Buddhism]] particularly [[Pure Land Buddhism]]
* [[Thus Spoke Zarathustra]] is highly influential on [[Lifeism]] but the link to Zoroastrianism and Zarathustra is questionable at best.
